evidence.note: Title states one finding: 12 and 14 Cross-town fell 14 and 11 points while the network fell 5; it is number-dense but a single claim.
Grouped Q2/Q3 bar chart: the 12 and 14 Cross-town Q3 bars (70%, 74%) visibly drop further than Network (81%) and Other six (87%), matching the title.
A Target 90% line is added above all bars; it is secondary context and does not compete with the route-drop message.
Left column has only two short captions (definition of the measure, and 'the two cross-town routes fell furthest; the other six held'), restating the title.
Insight tile over a blurred slide restates the same point: routes 12 and 14 account for almost all of the network's fall.

rationale: Title, chart, caption and insight all point the same way: the two cross-town routes drove the network's fall. The slide holds few elements (title, one chart, two short captions), and the dropped bars make the point visible at a glance, though the title's number density makes it slightly slower to restate. That matches the pass descriptor.
